bud018_declared_known_limitation: Resource identification under partial information is not separable from BUD-018's over-completion construct. A budget task that presents a finite resource enum and a saturating cap necessarily makes choosing what to retrieve part of what it measures, alongside whether to retrieve more once the answer is complete. This review can establish that the selection is adequately informed; it cannot factor the two capacities apart, and it does not claim to.
conclusion_means: Every offline, model-free gate this candidate can be held to before any provider exists is satisfied. It is not a qualification, not a provider finding, not a model finding, and not an execution authorization.
